invariants: Only a profile-named pre-protocol PairBlock may use the certification transition.
Certification requires a retained artifact with matching bytes and an explicit reason.
Every certified PairBlock identifies the terminal Phase 0 registration artifact required by P0-REQ-25.

findings.invariant: Every certified PairBlock identifies the terminal Phase 0 registration artifact required by P0-REQ-25.
findings.counterexample: The accepted success test certifies a block with evidence/terminal.json. Any repository file with its matching SHA-256 satisfies the controller and completion validator, even when it is not the terminal Phase 0 registration receipt.
